root.name: Sicilian Defense: Spielmann Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 d6 6. Nde2

overview: White plays the unusual 6.Nde2 in the Classical Sicilian with ...Nc6, retreating the knight to prepare Be3, g3 and f4 or a slow squeeze. Black can play ...e5 or ...g6 and the game becomes a quiet Sicilian. The position is flexible and there is little forcing play.

white_ideas.idea: Regroup with Be3, g3, Bg2 and castle
Keep the knights flexible and e4 solid

typical_structures.structure: Open Sicilian structure with the c-pawn gone
Black d6 pawn with half-open c-file

character.notes: Slow Sicilian with no forced play.

sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 c5 2. Nf3 d6 3. d4 cxd4 4. Nxd4 Nf6 5. Nc3 Nc6 6. Be2

character.reason: Neither side takes a risk early.

structure.reason: It is a Sicilian with a half-open c-file.

plans.reason: Black uses the c-file after the c-pawn exchange.
